action.message:
I edited the allowed file django/db/models/sql/query.py in Query.get_aggregation, adding a pass that detects aggregates containing an over clause and materializes referenced window annotations in the inner query, repointing the outer aggregate via Ref.

Honest verification status: the public regression selection ("aggregation") passes (124 tests, OK), but the host feature test test_referenced_window_requires_wrapping FAILED with "misuse of window function AVG()". My change is written to disk but does NOT fully satisfy the feature contract — the window function still ends up evaluated in the outer query context rather than being wrapped in a subquery so the outer aggregate operates on a plain column. The correct fix requires forcing the window annotation to be computed in a subquery and referenced as a subquery column (not the annotation expression itself). I ran out of the request budget before landing that correction, so the target behavior remains failing.
